message:
Per #482: apply review notes for WASI iovec handling

This PR applies the follow-up implementation notes from #482 / the WASI API review thread that was already signed off earlier.

The agreed direction there was to keep iovec translation as a thin marshaling step and avoid layering per-entry validation into the shared copy helpers / hot read-write paths, especially where the same behavior is already enforced at the syscall/backend boundary. This change is just the mechanical cleanup to align the three WASI backends with that prior decision:

- restore `copy_iov_to_host(...)` to a simple offset/length conversion helper
- remove the extra per-iovec memory checks and error plumbing added around the helper return path
- make the wasi / meta-wasi / uvwasi implementations consistent again

Why this follow-up:
- the current code diverged across backends after review
- the helper signature was expanded purely to thread error state through validation that we had already decided not to keep in this layer
- the duplicated checks add branching in the common fd read/write/pread/pwrite paths without changing intended API behavior

This PR does not introduce a new behavioral direction; it only implements the already-reviewed approach and removes the leftover validation/error-handling scaffolding that was inconsistent with that sign-off. Re-litigating whether iovec validation belongs in these marshaling helpers vs. the backend/syscall layer is out of scope for this follow-up, since that was covered in the earlier review.

Files touched:
- `source/m3_api_wasi.c`
- `source/m3_api_meta_wasi.c`
- `source/m3_api_uvwasi.c`

Net effect is a smaller, consistent iovec conversion path across the WASI variants.
